topic: Language, Proverbs: Talk at the table
title: Talking at the Table

explanation.tr:
Sofrada kullanılan kibar ifadeler:
• Bir şey istemek: Could you pass me the salt, please? / Can I have some bread, please?
• Teklif: Would you like some more tea? / Help yourself! (Buyurun, kendiniz alın!)
• Kabul: Yes, please. / That would be lovely.
• Ret: No, thank you. I'm full. (Doydum.)
• Övgü: This is delicious! / It tastes great!
• Başlarken: Enjoy your meal! (Afiyet olsun!)
• Teşekkür: Thank you for the meal. It was wonderful.
• Kalkmak için izin: May I leave the table?
explanation.tk:
Saçakda ulanylýan sypaýy aňlatmalar:
• Bir zat soramak: Could you pass me the salt, please? / Can I have some bread, please?
• Teklip: Would you like some more tea? / Help yourself! (Buýruň, özüňiz alyň!)
• Kabul etmek: Yes, please. / That would be lovely.
• Ret etmek: No, thank you. I'm full. (Doýdum.)
• Öwgi: This is delicious! / It tastes great!
• Başlanda: Enjoy your meal! (Işdäňiz açyk bolsun!)
• Minnetdarlyk: Thank you for the meal. It was wonderful.
• Turmak üçin rugsat: May I leave the table?
explanation.ru:
Вежливые фразы за столом:
• Попросить: Could you pass me the salt, please? / Can I have some bread, please?
• Предложить: Would you like some more tea? / Help yourself! (Угощайтесь!)
• Согласиться: Yes, please. / That would be lovely.
• Отказаться: No, thank you. I'm full. (Я наелся.)
• Похвалить: This is delicious! / It tastes great!
• В начале еды: Enjoy your meal! (Приятного аппетита!)
• Поблагодарить: Thank you for the meal. It was wonderful.
• Попросить разрешения встать: May I leave the table?

topic: Language, Proverbs: Where do you hear the following sentences?
title: Where Would You Hear This?

explanation.tr:
Bazı cümleler belirli yerlerde kullanılır. Anahtar kelimelere dikkat et:
• Havalimanı: boarding pass, gate, check-in, flight, departure
• Restoran: menu, order, bill, starter, main course
• Doktor: symptoms, prescription, temperature, medicine
• Otel: reservation, single/double room, key card, check out
• Dükkân: size, try on, changing room, receipt, discount
• Okul: homework, timetable, break, exam
• Banka: account, withdraw, deposit, exchange rate
• Tren istasyonu: platform, single/return ticket, delayed
explanation.tk:
Käbir sözlemler belli ýerlerde ulanylýar. Açar sözlere üns ber:
• Howa menzili: boarding pass, gate, check-in, flight, departure
• Restoran: menu, order, bill, starter, main course
• Lukman: symptoms, prescription, temperature, medicine

topic: Language, Proverbs: Words in language teaching

explanation.tr:
Dil derslerinde sık geçen kelimeler (talimatları anlamak için önemli):
• noun (isim), verb (fiil), adjective (sıfat), adverb (zarf), pronoun (zamir), preposition (edat), conjunction (bağlaç), article (artikel)
• sentence (cümle), paragraph (paragraf), vowel (ünlü), consonant (ünsüz), syllable (hece)
• singular (tekil), plural (çoğul), tense (zaman), spelling (yazım), pronunciation (telaffuz), meaning (anlam)
• Talimatlar: fill in the gaps (boşlukları doldur), match (eşleştir), underline (altını çiz), circle (daire içine al), tick (işaretle), translate (çevir), rewrite (yeniden yaz), correct the mistakes (hataları düzelt)
explanation.tk:

• sentence (sözlem), paragraph (abzas), vowel (çekimli), consonant (çekimsiz), syllable (bogun)
• singular (birlik), plural (köplük), tense (zaman), spelling (ýazylyş), pronunciation (aýdylyş), meaning (many)
• Tabşyryklar: fill in the gaps (boşluklary doldur), match (jübütle), underline (astyny çyz), circle (tegelege al), tick (bellik goý), translate (terjime et), rewrite (gaýtadan ýaz), correct the mistakes (ýalňyşlary düzet)
explanation.ru:
